note: Every figure the app shows comes from this file or from data/live.json. status: official = read on the issuer's own page; reported = official decision as reported by a named publication; secondary = market data site or aggregator; assumption = planning assumption, not a fact; unverified = not checked against a source yet.

ss.quarter.label: Small savings quarter in force
ss.quarter.source: Ministry of Finance (DEA) office memorandum of 30 Sep 2026, as reported by Business Standard
ss.quarter.note: Rates unchanged for the tenth straight quarter. Next review due around 31 Dec 2026.

repo.label: RBI repo rate
repo.source: RBI Monetary Policy Committee decision, 7 Oct 2026 (raised from 5.25%; stance: calibrated tightening), as reported by Business Standard

cpi.label: CPI inflation (year on year)
cpi.source: MoSPI press release of 12 Nov 2026, CPI base 2024=100, October 2026 (provisional)
cpi.note: September 2026 (final) was 5.54%. October is above the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit.

frsb.label: RBI Floating Rate Savings Bond 2020 (T) coupon
frsb.source: RBI press release 2026-2027/587: 8.05% (NSC 7.70% + 0.35%) for 1 Jul - 31 Dec 2026

gsec10.label: 10-year G-Sec yield
gsec10.source: Trading Economics / Investing.com closing value for 13 Nov 2026 (not the FBIL benchmark)

tbill91.label: 91-day T-Bill cut-off yield
tbill91.source: bondlab.in table citing the RBI auction of 27 Aug 2026
tbill91.note: Old: this is from before the October 2026 repo rate hike. Check the latest RBI auction result.

dicgc.label: DICGC deposit insurance cover
dicgc.source: DICGC newsletter Oct 2025 - Mar 2026: current coverage limit Rs 5,00,000 per depositor per bank (principal + interest)
dicgc.note: A proposal to raise it to Rs 7.5 lakh has been reported; no change notified.

goldDuty.label: Gold and silver import duty
goldDuty.source: Customs Notifications 15 to 18/2026 dated 12 May 2026: 10% basic customs duty + 5% AIDC, from 13 May 2026 (was 6%), as reported by TaxGuru
goldDuty.note: 3% GST applies on top when you buy physical gold.

sgbStatus.label: Sovereign Gold Bond new issues
sgbStatus.value: No new tranche since February 2024 (SGB 2023-24 Series IV). No issuance calendar for FY 2026-27.
sgbStatus.source: Business Today, 27 Jun 2026; RBI premature redemption calendar continues for existing bonds

sgbTax.label: SGB capital gains rule
sgbTax.value: From 1 Apr 2026 the exemption at redemption applies only to original subscribers who hold continuously to maturity. SGBs bought on the exchange are taxed: 12.5% if held over 12 months, slab rate otherwise.
sgbTax.source: Finance Act 2026, as explained by ClearTax and Taxmann

conduct.annual.label: Conduct rules: yearly intimation threshold
conduct.annual.source: DoPT OM F.No.11013/6/2018-Estt.A-III dated 7 Feb 2019: intimation in the prescribed proforma if total transactions in shares, securities, debentures and mutual funds exceed six months' basic pay in a calendar year; due by 31 January of the next year
conduct.annual.note: Sales and purchases both count. Check for any department-specific instructions with your office.

conduct.single.label: Conduct rules: single movable-property transaction
conduct.single.value: Over 2 months' basic pay: report within one month
conduct.single.source: CCS (Conduct) Rules 1964, Rule 18(3), as summarised by indianpaycalculator.in; read the rule text or ask your office

conduct.speculation.label: Conduct rules: speculation
conduct.speculation.value: Rule 16(1): no Government servant shall speculate in any stock, share or other investment. Frequent purchase and sale is treated as speculation.
conduct.speculation.source: DoPT OM of 7 Feb 2019 quoting Rule 16(1)

ups.option.label: UPS option for new recruits
ups.option.value: Choose within 30 days of joining using Form A1. If you do nothing you stay in NPS. A one-time, one-way switch from UPS back to NPS exists.
ups.option.source: PFRDA Unified Pension Scheme page and FAQs

tax.act.label: Income-tax law in force
tax.act.value: Income-tax Act, 2025, from 1 Apr 2026. First 'tax year' is 2026-27. Rates carried over unchanged; section numbers changed.

tax.newSlabs.label: New regime slabs, tax year 2026-27
tax.newSlabs.value: Up to 4 lakh nil; 4-8 lakh 5%; 8-12 lakh 10%; 12-16 lakh 15%; higher slabs above. Rebate: no tax if total income is up to Rs 12 lakh. Standard deduction Rs 75,000 for salary.
tax.newSlabs.source: taxaj.com rate page for tax year 2026-27; Budget 2026 made no slab change
tax.newSlabs.note: Capital gains taxed at special rates do not get the rebate. Confirm your own figure with a CA or the official calculator.

tax.equity.label: Equity shares and equity funds
tax.equity.value: Held over 12 months: 12.5% on gains above Rs 1.25 lakh a year. Held 12 months or less: 20%.
tax.equity.source: Tax year 2026-27 rates (sections 196 and 198 of the 2025 Act), Tycoonstory and Bajaj Finserv summaries

tax.debtMf.label: Debt mutual funds bought on or after 1 Apr 2023
tax.debtMf.value: All gains taxed at your slab rate, whatever the holding period.

tax.gold.label: Gold and silver
tax.gold.value: Gold/silver ETF: long-term after 12 months. Gold fund-of-funds, physical and digital gold: long-term after 24 months. Long-term gains 12.5% without indexation; short-term at slab rate.
tax.gold.source: ClearTax and Aditya Birla Capital guides for FY 2026-27

tax.interest.label: Interest income (FD, RD, NSC, TD, MIS, FRSB, SGB interest)
tax.interest.value: Added to your income and taxed at your slab rate. PPF interest is exempt.
tax.interest.source: Scheme tax tables, PaisaMarket and Paybima summaries of the Oct-Dec 2026 rates

fd.sbi1y.label: SBI FD, 1 year (general)
fd.sbi1y.source: PensionBazaar rate table dated 15 Nov 2026; peak 6.40% for 2 years to under 3 years

fd.hdfc1y.label: HDFC Bank FD, 1 year (general)
fd.hdfc1y.source: Paisabazaar / Policybazaar tables (they disagree on the peak: 6.50% vs 6.60%)

ppf.rules.label: PPF rules
ppf.rules.value: Rs 500 to Rs 1.5 lakh a financial year, in multiples of Rs 50. Matures 15 financial years after the year of opening; extend in 5-year blocks. Loan in years 3 to 6. Partial withdrawal from the 7th financial year, once a year. Interest on the lowest balance between the 5th and month end, credited yearly.
ppf.rules.source: PPF Scheme 2019 as summarised by several bank pages (HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank) and beincareer.com

td.rules.label: Post Office Time Deposit rules
td.rules.value: Minimum Rs 1,000, no maximum. Interest compounded quarterly, paid yearly. No closure in the first 6 months. Only the 5-year TD counts for the old-regime Rs 1.5 lakh deduction.
td.rules.source: indianpaycalculator.in and richify.ai tables for Oct-Dec 2026

mssc.label: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate
mssc.value: Closed. The two-year scheme was not extended beyond 31 March 2025.

ibja.terms.label: IBJA rate terms
ibja.terms.value: Rates exclude 3% GST and making charges. IBJA advises anyone using its rates for pricing or financial products to subscribe to the official IBJA API.

ipo.rules.label: Mainboard IPO application rules
ipo.rules.value: One lot is sized at about Rs 10,000 to Rs 15,000 at the upper price band. Retail = applications up to Rs 2 lakh; at least 35% of a profitable company's issue is reserved for retail. Oversubscribed retail portions are allotted by lottery, one lot each. UPI mandates up to Rs 5 lakh.
ipo.rules.source: SEBI ICDR Regulations as summarised by calcguru.in and Anand Rathi
ipo.rules.note: SEBI's October 2026 consultation paper proposes changes to SME minimums; a proposal, not a rule.

ipo.sme.label: SME IPO rules
ipo.sme.value: Minimum application is two lots and above Rs 2 lakh. No cut-off price option.
ipo.sme.source: ICDR Reg 267(2) as summarised by calcguru.in

data.blocked.label: Sources that refuse automated access from GitHub servers
data.blocked.value: NSE and BSE (index levels, IPO pages), PIB and Business Standard RSS. Tested 16 Nov 2026. Index levels and live IPO subscription need a broker market-data API key.
data.blocked.source: NiveshPath probe run on GitHub Actions

assumptions.note: Planning assumptions only. They are not forecasts and not sourced facts. Change them in Settings.

sovereign.label: PPF and other sovereign savings (PPF rate can change every quarter)

deposit.label: Bank FD / Post Office TD, before tax

equity.label: Nifty 50 index fund, long-run, before tax

ipos.name: Mahanadi Coalfields (Coal India subsidiary)
ipos.source: ipoplatform.com and ipoguru.in; price band not announced when checked
ipos.note: Check the RHP for any Coal India shareholder quota and its record date.

ipoWatch.note: Names reported in the pipeline. Unconfirmed until an RHP with dates exists.
